query: select json_build_object('profiles', coalesce((select json_agg(row_to_json(x)) from (select p.user_id, p.display_name, p.role, p.is_active, u.created_at, u.last_seen_at from public.profiles p join public.users u on u.id = p.user_id where p.user_id in ('1a6880b0-5169-47fc-a490-fd700275632b'::uuid, '4e658ebb-4b2f-4c01-8ee8-e56fc201c673'::uuid, 'd03fc0f2-f189-487c-b58f-2bc06e3aa59a'::uuid) order by p.user_id limit 10) x), '[]'::json), 'merchant_profiles', coalesce((select json_agg(row_to_json(x)) from (select user_id, business_name, legal_name, verification_status, verified_at, created_at from public.merchant_profiles where user_id = '4e658ebb-4b2f-4c01-8ee8-e56fc201c673'::uuid limit 5) x), '[]'::json), 'stores', coalesce((select json_agg(row_to_json(x)) from (select id, merchant_id, name_ar, status, is_verified, created_at, updated_at from public.stores where id = '32fb6bdd-ceb4-4a8b-b6a1-1ac92c466c47'::uuid limit 5) x), '[]'::json), 'products', coalesce((select json_agg(row_to_json(x)) from (select id, store_id, name_ar, product_type, status, is_featured, created_at, updated_at from public.products where id = '91351884-521b-43d5-9869-aa3a178ebf94'::uuid limit 5) x), '[]'::json)) as acceptance_baseline from (select 1) as probe limit 1;
